title: ClaimEvidence
description: Provenance record for a personalized or flattering claim used in outreach drafts or episode briefs. Every such claim must trace to a real, verifiable source and must be explicitly approved before it can appear in external-facing material. A draft whose claims contain any unapproved or unverified entry MUST be refused by the draft engine. This schema enforces the design rule: claim → source → verified date → approved for external use.

claim.description: The exact claim text as it will appear (or closely resemble) in the outreach draft or brief. No paraphrasing — what is written here is what must be traceable.

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the public source that substantiates this claim. Must be a real, externally reachable source — not an internal document or a description of a conversation.

verified_date.description: ISO 8601 date on which the claim was verified against the source URL.

approved_for_external_use.description: True only when a human reviewer has confirmed this claim is accurate, fair, and appropriate for use in outreach or published material. False means the claim must not appear in any external-facing text.
